text: This game is surely a great one, however its not fair that you get only two raids for each time you play. I may be having thousands of spins but I end up getting only two raids and like 3 4 attacks, thus wasting all my other spins. Also instead of buying chests 1 by 1, what if you put the option of choosing how many chests we want to buy based on the coins we have? Thanks to consider.

At the beginning I enjoyed and really liked this game but when I played for a long time I lost my interest because I feel that the resources given especially for the cards are very small, especially for the gold cards and the others are repeated and it takes a long time to refill the spins. I was able to spend money but I wasted my money because they don't give enough resources and the constructions are even more expensive. That's it, don't spend and waste too much money on this game like me. 😔

Very addictive and fun ,enjoy it very much. But I have been having a problem where if my internet connection is bad and it cuts of in the middle of trying to collect rewards from quest or finishing a village or even claiming the gifts given by coin master . It just doesn't give me the reward when I get connected again or just says you already use this link( gift) which I didn't get the chance to .

I am a high level player (over 6000) stars and I've spent alot of my own money on this game. However customer support are useless. My second accounts village has doubled in price and they refuse to fix it even when I provide evidence to show the village prices are incorrect and are more expensive then others. I won't be spending another penny.

This game is cluttered with pop-ups to entice you to pay for it, and the "random chance" is heavily leaning towards the smalles prize you can get on anything that SHOULD be random. Ontop of that, the devs don't even read these reviews, and reply to them with maybe 3-5 different iterations between each reply (just read some of the reviews and see). This is just the biggest cash grab there is, and the mascot of this game (the pig stealing a gold coin) perfectly depicts the devs of this game.

This is actually pretty fun, but as you have the capability to attack and defend from other players, and you get your attacks and defences from a slot machine, and you pay for the slot machine, AND you can purchase more turns on the slot machine, I would consider it pay to win. Nevertheless, it is fun to keep coming back to and to keep advancing.

Was a fun game, but increasingly became harder to do anything without spending money. Go into it realizing that if it says the reward is (for example) 1-1000, you'll only ever get 1-10. You'll only ever receive the lowest rewards, no matter how high it seems you can get. You'll always be left reeeeeally close to the next reward, no matter what you do, you'll need to spend to get over the line. Even that's not a guarantee. Developer greed is sucking the fun out of it. My team all agrees.

Game concept & graphics are great however everything becomes too expensive. You need lots of spins to really enjoy this game & the best way is to complete sets. Just spent 117B coins on buying extra cards (430M per chest). 3276 cards later I got 5 new cards. That's a reward ratio of less than 0.2%. Sort your algorithms out please. Buying those coins would cost over £11K. Even with the current "offer" would cost £915. Your pricing/packages need to be reviewed too!

on 01/04/2019, I spent £7.99 on 200+ spins and a free gift. The money was taken from my bank account but I never recieved my purchase, and according to the support team they can't reimburse me even though i have proof of recipet. This has never happened before, if nothing is done about it i will be contacting PayPal and the problem will be theirs.

Not a bad game although it's an online game only (bad news for those w/o a permanent data plan) with simple controls though. The idea for trading cards is nice but hard to get the ones you needs to complete collections (especially with a limited friend list) trading online seems hit-&-miss. Wish you could 'sell' duplicate cards in game without waiting for special card event, then use coins to buy more spins/missing cards instead of chests in the hope you FINALLY get that one card you need

A fun and simple game with no skill required to play. The only slight annoyance is that it says this game is "more fun with friends", but actually, you always end up with your friends popping up for raids and attacks more frequently. Which means if one friend is playing for 30 mins when you aren't, they can completely decimate your village where as you can't multi attack the strangers?? Doesn't make sense. If they fix that it would be higher.

Boring - I don't understand the appeal of this game. It's just one or two things you do non-stop with no variety and no real sense of progression. The 'levels' seem copy-pasted as you are just mildly improving the same set of core elements per 'village'. This game takes no effort to play and is not engaging in the slightest. I feel bad for anyone who spent money on this game as per the other negative reviews.

This game is trash. I clearly won spins and chest because I am a third placer in the team event but it says that I didn't win anything. It is also hard to get spins if your village is already in a high level. Such a disappoinment. It was fun and addicting at first, it cleared the boredom in me, but now I am pissed. It's also hard to enter the game, it always says that there is a problem in connection, when clearly there was none. Also, there is problem on giving spins when u invite friends.

Unfortunately you are getting a 1 star from me. It turned out after speaking to your support team I have reached the limit for adding new accounts . At lvl 165 I was explained how I can get a spin from each friend . Hilarious. A village is 30 billions and above and what I need to wait a month or two to collect the spins to move onto the next lvl. So disappointing after investing lots of time and strategies to get this far. Anyway I will not recommend this game.

For some reason.... You play as a guest or even try to log into your account it automatically stops working or if you go in as a guest comes up with everything, builds one house, it loads then does nothing... Goes back to your home screen well waste download make sure the game work properly. Back to the drawing board 😊 hope it helps feedback always good!

Great game! really fun+ addictive. On mobiles it works well, but bugs need fixing cause of glitches on kindle fire, very slow, always crashes, cant send spins/coins or cards, almost always crashes during raids and when buying chests and when i complained about it, only recieved initial response email asking for more information , which i provided and heard no response since. Otherwise its great. Wouldn't recommend using a kindle as it makes the game very stressful

Fun at first, but impossible to progress as you get to later levels. Even if you buy packs, it is never enough to progress a village quickly enough before someone destroys it. 15 popups telling you to buy stuff when you load in gets ridiculous. Recent changes to the game have been made to screw you further; you can no longer put pets to sleep to stop their timers, making them useless as you will never continuously spin for four hours.

As someone who has paid to play, I say don't. When there is an error and you lose out on rewards, they won't rectify the issue. In fact, they don't seem to read emails well. Confusing two different issues. The only time you need customer service is when things go wrong. The problem is when they still refuse to rectify it. Creating losses and putting you further back in the game. You need to pay play, as you can't keep up with the game without doing so.

Was fun until lately. They do not respond to your complaints. I didnot get set completion rewards and mailed to CM more than 6,7 times and still they ignore my complaints. Latest events were all ment to reduce your spins. They do not have a fairplay algorithm anymore. All they seek is to make money with pack purchases. Lost 10 k spins in an instant without even getting a single hit playing at 100 bet. So i uninstalled it then after.

Used to love this game but now i am fed up of it! Barely any attacks or raids when events are on, Viking Quest is only beneficial to those that have a large amount of either spins or money! Most tournaments are impossible to get 1st place! Several time i have not received spins i have won... as for completing sets and villages!! It's ridiculous how much you have to get before completing villages! Card are almost ALWAYS duplicated and you wait MONTHS for Gold Ones... don't bother playing!!

I enjoyed playing CM! I invited a lot of friends to get free spins. However, just recently I had 2 to 3 attacks x 5 bet and didn't add to its gauge to get the 1k free spins. I guess there was a technical problem. Then tonight, after I ran out of spins I had 4,500,000+ left so I shopped for 4,100,000+ but couldn't buy the item. I tried few times but it would only say not enough coins!

The game has many bugs related to friends invite. 1. Says my link was not used to download the game, even though I sent the link and clicked on the link personally. 2. Says my friend did not complete the tutorial, even though I was the one to use his phone and completed the tutorial. 3. Added loads of friends but apparently after 100 friends, no free spins were awarded per invite, just the prize at the end of the bar was given, which was not what the invite page said. Very disappointed!

Overall this game is fun and addictive. I only have 3 stars because I think you should get full spins or topped up to full spins after 2 hours, you should be able to send as many different cards to as many different people as you want and you shouldn't have to pay to get your pet snacks, you should be able to buy them with coins on the game just like you can buy chests of cards. Thanks, I just wanted to voice my opinion of this game. Lexi

Not very good at all.. the idea behind the game is very clever and it would be a very enjoyable game play if the developers where even remotely bothered about they're players. They fix the game, take spins and rewards you've spent all week earning, take payment for a purchase which failed to.download and dont care when you report it and cannot be bothered replying to an email when you raise concerns, problems or issues. Very poor. I'll not be playing again.

It's too bad this game turned into such a money grab. It used to be so much fun, I even made a couple in app purchases. But now you can't play for more than a couple minutes before you get stuck at another pay wall. And in app purchases have become stupidely overpriced. You're also being constantly bombarded with purchase pop-ups, new cards are impossible to get, and chests are always the lowest possible value. This overpriced garbage will be losing my purchases, and I will be uninstalling.

Used to enjoy the game but the recent updates (removing the ability to save pet food by putting pet to sleep until spins refill) and the fact that it's almost impossible to get new cards and the cost involved in completing villages means it's now very boring. A full set of spins used on level 100 and I still don't have enough to upgrade 1 thing. No point to playing for days like that. Shame.

I have been playing this game for over 2 years now, so obviously LOVE THE GAME!!! However, I DON'T love the outrageous costs for building up the villages, etc., and the chintzy prize amounts, in comparison. I am at level 363 and requiring ~10 or 11 trillion coins to build up an entire village (unless I have a good discount to use) is quite ridiculous. Please consider reducing the costs of building AND increasing the prize amounts accordingly. Thank you.👵😼

Absolutely appalling how the makers of this game constantly push "special" offers trying to get you to purchase them! It can be upto 10 pop ups every time you log in, run out of lives etc! Im close to deleting the game, I do not need to be reminded how to add friends or try to sell me add ons constantly! Spins also take way too long to replenish. Shame really, I've started to play Royal match and not once have I had a pop up! I know where the offers are as they are plastered all over the game!!

have been playing Coin Master for over 5 years, the longest relationship I've come close to fully committing to in my life. enjoy how they always have different places (sites) where you can click and get more spins and coins. The extra world's and tasks outside of just spinning keep me occupied for hours if allow it to be that time consuming. That's why enjoy this game, you can play at any pace and still have fun. It doesn't negatively impact u if a tournament is missed.good good

You just took the fun away from this game by making it impossible to trade more than 5 cards per day! We, the players are not your enemies, we keep you going! There is other things where you could make a change: putting a limit on how much one can spend real money for example! Till things change, I am going to uninstall the app!

I loved this game. And I made purchases all the time, however one instance ruined it all. I made a purchase not realizing I had to make two to move on to the free items. It was a total waste of money being as I could have spent $1 more on another one for the same prizes. Instead it was expected to make another $6 purchase to get to the free items. I contacted support to have it reversed and they would not do it. Told me I used the spins even though they were still in my account. Don'tpay toplay

The pop-ups absolutely ruin this game. They are incessant and sometimes even obstruct the game play, for instance when balloons float up the screen you can't pop them when 5+ adverts pop-up in quick succession. They definitely make me 100% less likely to put money into this game, let alone recommend to a friend. Having the deals in small bubbles in the top left of the play screen is PLENTY of publicising to let me know how and where to purchase additional spins, cards and coins.

This is not a game. There is no strategy, no tactics, and no decision making. This is bright colours, big numbers, and pop ups to try to take all your money. The game uses the usual predatory tactics, easy first levels and cheap first purchases in an attempt to get you hooked. It doesn't matter that the game is not fun, or even a game. They just want you to buy some spins and then they move on to your Facebook friends. Scummy "game". Avoid. Also, so many fake reviews.

I liked the game but it's really annoying that all the time there are pop ups one after the other for you to pay money on the game. It's continuous and it gets annoying until the point that I had deleted the game cause I stopped enjoying it cause I was spending more time closing this pop ups than the time i was actually playing..

I enjoyed playing this in the begining but later i have grown fruatrated. I have spent months buys chests and have not got any new cards. I have more than 11 sets to complete. Whats the point in playing if the developers are too self to give a new card. Do you want yours players to leave the game? Stop making a fool of yourself. Get the problem fixed and get better reviews.

Glitch & pop ups! I have been playing this for a while now, and I do love the game yet there has been a few times when I've won a steal and the money (or the points of the event) haven't shown and still taken my sins off me for it! This morning, I got the steal I needed to win 3.7K of spins! Proper chuffed yet after I finished the steal nothing showed up AGAIN! ALSO: The constant adds are super annoying.

Still rate this as a one star once again. It takes longer to get through the multiple pop ups/ads at the start of the game than the time you get to play anything. Card drops are really poor and underwhelming. I've still tried for over two years for standered unlocks but no luck. For your own sanity please don't download. It's cheaper to go out and loose money at a slot machine than to pay anything for this game.

You only get so far. I got stuck on the 4th village because I couldn't win enough money in one go to upgrade my buildings. On time I managed to win 4 million but it was stolen from me before I could spend it. No point in trying to 'save up' either because your money gets stolen before you open the app again. Good gameplay but ruined by unrealistic goals.

This is stupid game as there is no limit of someone attacking you. I play day and night to build village spending my time all in it and it took only few minutes for my friend to damage it all. I can't unfriend my friends just for this game for sure. However, there has to be some limit on how much a person can attack on other person. Feeling like I wasted my time playing this game, in which developers don't even bother about players because whole my time was wasted in few minutes by my friend.

Disclaimer: I only installed this game to get currency in another game. Decently addictive and very simple core gameplay loop, but that's it. No skill required and there's no challenge whatsoever except for the constant test of your patience with the unbelievably obnoxious, endless pop-ups after every single time you run out of spins. Six pop-ups in a row is outrageous.

love the game . so addictive . but costing me too much . won't spend any more .I think this is why it's so hard to progress because they want you to spend spend spend . just give a little bit more to make it more enjoyable rather than frustrating. Will review again in 2weeks. Cm have killed the game . Friends I have deleted or blocked on fb are still in my game . A Lot more attacks and raise etc . Some very systematic . Cm need to fix this asap . I have been through support in the game .

it's okay, it's simple and fun for a little while as a time passer. However there is little you can do without spending real money! I'd like it better if there were options to watch ads for little things like that! I would definitely watch them to get rewards. There's also a lot of pop-ups, not ads, just the game trying to sell you "deals" as soon as you open the app

You barely get anything with spins when you reach a certain level, you're raided constantly AS SOON as you get cash and the daily bonus spinner looks like its going to stop and then speeds up and stops at a lesser amount. Don't waste your time, Board Kings has a lot more going for it, mini games, free rolls are easier to get etc.

Fantastic game normally but have recently been experiencing some glitches. Attack hasn't been working properly, sometime doesn't attack, sometime doesn't register attack rewards. Yesterday I completed 120 spins on the latest challenge and shouldn't e won 175m coins but coins never got added! A bit disappointing lately. Fix glitches and make sure rewards are given and it will be a great game once again!

Starting to get real fed up with aspects of this game. I've had to contact support at least twice before due to errors with the game that have caused me to lose spins/money. Today, yet another occasion where I spent money to upgrade something in my village, and because one of your stupid bots raided me about 10 seconds AFTER I upgraded the item, all the money was taken for the item upgrade, AND no star, no item upgrade, like my 530 mil never existed. Just get rid of bots too please. Joke.

It's a fun game and good to kill time but My rating would be more if the rate at which you receive new cards was better. When you first start you get an influx but the further you go the harder it is to get new cards. I must have spent over 2.5b on chests and received 1 or 2. When this improves so will my rating. Also as a side note the pop ups get far too annoying everytime I open the game. I think there should be an option to not show the pop up once you've seen it.

Its already the 3rd time that I had invited people by sending them links to the game and I wasn't able to receive the invite rewards even after they successfully finish the 1st village and added me to their friend list. It's like mt effort to convince this people to play this game is put into nothing. Urghhh I hope that you can fix this kind of issue.

I really like this game. The only problem I have with the game is the popups to add friends etc is a bit annoying. Why have these pop up all the time. Make a button and if I want to add people I will invite. The huge downside to this is if there are balloons or lanterns rising up these windows cover them and you miss out on bonuses. Please make these buttons instead of popups. It would make the game 5 stars for me.

Love the game, but why can i no longer play on my laptop?????? 😔😬😧😖😫😫 I have to uninstall as I spend so much money on it, if I didn't pay for stuff the game wouldn't be fun at all, especially now I'm at such a high level. It costs about 80 billion to buy one chest now and the limited rolls I get a day I rarely even get a raid or attack, sometimes I never even get a billion so can't buy anything. I've spent hundreds ££ a month 😭😳

Spin cost is a bit pricey, then you will still unable to complete the ongoing task because spin chances tend to get really crappy! Spend billions and billions purchasing chests for cards then there's an instance where you will only get 1 new card for that! Also for timed event (like blasts, viking or etc) the spinning time is to slow and then you won't get the set of spin item you needed and it takes too much time when drawing the cards from chests it is getting annoying and a pain.!!!!! 🤬😡

I like this game and have been playing for a while now. But villages are getting harder and harder to build as you go up. Chests are getting more expensive to purchase too which is kinda unfair. And the probability of getting new cards as you open new decks is getting slimmer and slimmer which is a waste of coins and disappointing. What's worse is I purchased a trade for 400M, and the game froze I did not get any. It happened to me few times so I stopped playing.

Very bad i bought spins and they gave me things then when I exit the game, they gave me a better offer at the same price such a con game and they are raking a lot of money. There are also too many pop ups and it is very annoying. I spent $15 and they only give 235 spins and I thought it will be 400. I wish they can increase the amount of spins so it will be worth it. Right now, I feel like being scammed. I wish they can decrease the timing and give more spins

I have spent billions of coins on chests just to keep having the same ones you could at least give a few new cards other than the same ones all the time it's really stressful when you need just one card to complete a set but you will never complete it because you never get a chance for new cards shocking if you ask me I've been playing this game for years

I did give 3 stars originally with this review Game is good overall. However you buy several chests and spend ridiculous amounts of money only to find that you are given the same cards over and over again. Golds are near enough non existent and you cannot seem to complete your sets because of this issue. However now I am lowering the stars because, no response to my emails regarding glitches crashes and not receiving rewards, spins and coins. I am not the only one either.

Pop ups everywhere! How many times do things need to pop up before you can play. Ridiculous. 1 star now until you take them off. I don't need to see the same pop ups a million times a day. If I'm out of spins and want to buy them I'll go buy them! Seriously just take them off. Edit: you've obviously not taken it into consideration as they're getting worse. Honestly why do you need to spam buy this buy that, invite friends, oh this is on today special offer etc. You're running a good game.

This game used to be Fun, but there seems to be a new algorithm where you just raid your friends. It used to be a balance of friends and strangers. I keep logging in and having my village absolutely devasted. By two of my friends whoplay the game in a matter of a couple hours. It's just not fun anymore and now it feels like a chore. Can take weeks to make a new village now because of this update so I just can't be bothered.

I enjoyed the game until it broke and it won't work again for me. I played this game for years and paying for micro transactions to get my account to where it was. Until this 6am this morning (currently now 1:20pm) where it came up with the same error code over and over and over and wouldn't let me access my account. I tried to access my account on a different device but it does the same thing but it does let me create a new account. I haven't heard back off their support team either.

It won't download 100%, cannot get any of the additional prizes when get 3 hammers, cannot play viking quest etc. Have contacted the support team for a month now to be told to do the same thing over and over again but it doesn't work. I have checked my inbox to read the same response the support team keeps emailing stating they will send this to the technical team and thanks for my patience - but the technical team never respond.

This game like drugs to me and my friends 😂🔥 Soo much fun in it 🤍 Update: lately the game getting lagging so much in last couple weeks in June till now . And it's become rare to show in the chests new cards to complete sets and also it's hard to get spins or even win in events! Unfortunately it's getting boring to wait for the spin bar filled or getting some free spins daily. It's getting hard for a fun game.

My opinion is pretty much the same as the others on here it's great to play at first cos you get the spins, the coins, the cards, the chests, quests get complete and it helps you move up the levels but then when you get to level 200 or more it gets too hard to get spins,coins, build villages, cards become non existent, and gold cards are like rocking horse muck. Takes the fun our of playing the game. 😌😕

This "game" if it can even be called that, is awful. It's spinning a wheel and "building" villages (clicking a button to build things that have no function or purpose, they just exist and then you move on to the next village). Out of spins? Can't play the game, and you get absolutely peppered with pop-ups begging you to spend money or invite friends. Its emblematic of all the things that make mobile games these days awful. Its barely a game. Save yourself the time and do something else.

the game itself is fun and great to play, only down side is there is not enough of being able to swap gold cards and then when you can it's only a certain one, this does not help new players. I also find that I'm spending alot of money on chests but not getting new cards which is annoying.

I saw this ad on other games and it was like "oh another celebrities paid game" but then I found out my family and some friends played so I gave it a go and was surprised‚ it is pretty fun. It is tempting to spend money but you don't really have to if you just play casually. You get shields often enough that being hit isn't annoying and makes progressing in the game pretty fun. Been playing a while haven't hit a paywall yet. I don't make reviews often so this should say something.

This game started out good 2 years ago when I started playing it. Now it's virtually impossible to get anywhere on the game unless I purchase anything. It wasn't yo bad when you could send more than 5 cards you could trade for cards you need. Now tgeg stopped this it will be impossible to get any further. I'm gonna uninstall the game no poj t trying there's no fun anymore. It's harder than working to get anywhere villages cost to much to build chests are to expensive. They even ruined vikings

I have been playing this game from last 3 months. But in the recent event of 12 symbol, i didn't get symbol in 1000 spins. I lost more then 3000 spins in it and got nothing. This is the worst event ever and because of the loss i will stop playing Coin Master now. This is really frustrating. Kindly refund my 3k spins or else keep the 1 star review and decrease your rating everyday.

The amount of things that pop up as you load the game up it stupid. It's always the same the events that always popping up. Its just not needed. It glitches out alot I had about 50 spins and the game glitched and went down to 0. Also when you run out of spins the amount on things that pop up isn't needed. It doesnt need to pop up all the time. However all the negitives aside its a good game and I do like it the graphics are awesome and it takes a good imagination to come up with all the villages

I used to enjoy the game. It was a nice release from day-to-day life. I've paid into the game. A couple hundred dollars. Canadian (worth more than the US dollar.) And I've been buying into and playing for quite some time now.. I'm perturbed that there's a 4th of July but not an acknowledgement to Canada? And looking at the data for players in my country... That's offensive. And we're not offended by much

Yesterday also I had an issue. Though my money was deducted from my account twice i haven't received the item which I purchased. I have already contacted cm. But it was not solved so far. You sent a message. that's all.you frequently say that there is too much traffic. It is not the first time that iam losing my money. More than 24 hours elapsed. When i submitted the ticket i received a message regarding the abnormal traffic. Its just an unjust thing. 0 is my rating. But below 1 is not found.

Can't play Wildland adventure, a few times occurs like this if the time left less than 24 hours. Got 70k spin can't claim it. It used to be a good game, but now it is average. The developer only wants you to spend the money, not for playing this game for fun or anything, only money they want from the player. Now something is wrong with the game, always saying my connection is unstable. When I play other games, all is fine. Fix the issue ASAP

Great game, very addicting....but unless you're willing to spend money (and not just pennies)....you won't get far. It is very hard to get a substantial amount of spins, unless you make a purchase. I understand making money off a game, but this is a little much. I've been playing and spending for the last few months, but am almost ready to uninstall...because of this (and I know quite a few people who have, already).

The waiting times for spins are very long i find which is annoying but also as I'm writing this maybe 5 minutes ago i won 275million coins from a event just for them all to disappear without reason which is incredibly frustrating when i tried going to support to fix the issue there was no sort of help for me since they only explained how to fix common issues and i guess this wasn't a common one i would loves if the devs were either able to add a section to help or reply to this please!

The game is ok. It's good for a fine minute play every now and then. However, the pop up 'invite your friends, connect to Facebook, buy this stuff' every time I open it is getting a little grating. I have no wish to connect to Facebook. I have no wish to invite my friends. I play it when I've got five minutes down time. Either stop the ridiculous amount of pop ups, or give users the chance to permanently disable them.

Glitches non stop. When contacting the support team with screen shots proving that you're not receiving rewards that you've won, depending on who you're speaking to you will not be credited for them. Constant server errors. During the lower levels it was fun but as soon as you hit level 50 you start having serious technical issues. Will be deleting the game. Also the pop ups are over the top and you miss balloon/ghost rewards due to the pop ups which is really disappointing.

I enjoyed this game in the first stages but as you progress to keep it interesting you have to spend money,the developers are blatantly more after your money than keeping the game enjoyable ,They need to make money. But i want to play games for more than five minutes every hour, by the time you've accumulated five spins your village has been attacked and any coins you did have are gone and five spins is not enough to accrue enough coins to progress.

Please add more card collections. All mine are completed and takes forever to get to the new level to unlock new ones. The last new collections were added ages ago. I have spent quite a lot of money on this game but I bored now as I am stuck most of the time and im getting pretty tired of spending my money. I mean 11 billion for one upgrade is pretty ridiculous

I dislike when it tells you to retry the connection when you have full service and every other game works besides this one. I love playing this game when it works. The other thing that annoys me is when you run out of spins on any of the x1, x3 etc. and it asks you if you wanna buy more or invite people. I'd like it to just ask once not everytime.

Really dissapointed- I have been playing this game for over a year and mostly enjoying it. Today I spent money for the first time because I really wanted to win the card in one of th challenges. I had 1300 spins and somehow didn't get a single match. Once I start spending money on these things I tend to spend too much but I'm just not entertaining this one anymore. I have uninstalled and won't be playing again.

The technical support team has not been helpful. I have been reporting the same problem and nothing is being done. Every time they send you 200 spins and everything cool but you are loosing more than that. If I could of ranked the customer service and issues I've been having with this app it would be -0.00000000000. update...
